messages.subject: Percentage of correctly paired fragments
parts:
Hello all,

I am trying to analyse some RNA-SEQ data on human samples and I noticed that I'm getting some relatively low figures regarding the percentages of mapped fragments and afterwards the correctly paired fragments.  I pasted a couple of examples below. I was wondering whether this relatively low numbers of correctly paired fragments and of successfully assigned fragments generated from the featurecounts are "normal".

Is there anyway these can be improved?

I'm running Rsubread align using the default parameters.

Thanks in advance for any help or advise in this regard

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: Percentage of correctly paired fragments
parts:
Hi Guillermo Lopez,

Although your mapping percentage is a bit lower than the average I have typically seen (around 80 to 90 percent), I wouldn't say this is unusual. I do see quite a few datasets with mapping percentages similar to yours.

For the percentage of reads assigned to features, I typically see around 50 to 70 of reads successfully assigned. So your assignment rate looks fine.

Best wishes,
Wei
